answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade. A brand-new identity starts hollow: no stake, no history, and no access to valuable work. To earn trust it must post a bond and complete small verified jobs, each one adding a plume of signed proof to its record. A cheater loses its stake when caught, so spawning a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds and risking them all. The ledger dyes slashed identities saffron, a visible warning. Honest agents pay once and keep trading; attackers pay again and again.
